title: feat: Round 2 — 10 new features: pipeline, interviews, assessments, saved jobs, job alerts, PWA, insights, social sharing, employer analytics
head: feat/modern-features
body:
10 new features built from 2026 recruitment technology trends research.

1. Application Tracking Pipeline — drag-and-drop Kanban board with 6 stages (matched, screening, interviewing, offer, hired, rejected). Employers drag candidate cards between stages. Stage changes trigger push notifications to candidates.

2. Interview Scheduling — schedule video/phone/in-person interviews after matching. Interview cards show type icon, date/time, duration, meeting link, location, and notes. Upcoming and history sections. Status updates (complete, cancel) notify the other party.

3. Skills Assessments — employers create quizzes attached to jobs with multiple-choice questions tagged by skill. Candidates see a 'Take Assessment' badge on job cards. Interactive quiz UI with progress bar, question navigation, and auto-scoring. Passing score boosts match score. Results stored per candidate.

4. Saved/Bookmarked Jobs — candidates tap a bookmark icon on any job card to save it. Saved jobs page with full job details, one-tap unsave. Save state persists across swipe sessions.

5. Job Alerts — candidates create custom alert preferences (keywords, location, salary minimum, job types, skills). Alerts appear as filterable cards with one-tap delete. Foundation for scheduled notification runs.

6. PWA Support — manifest.json with standalone display mode, theme color matching brand, icon support. Layout exports viewport with themeColor. App is now installable on mobile devices.

7. Swipe Insights Dashboard — candidate analytics showing total swipes, likes, passes, matches, like rate, match rate. Bar charts for top liked skills, top locations, and preferred job types. Powered by the swipe analytics engine from Round 1.

8. Social Sharing — share buttons on every job card for WhatsApp, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, and copy link. Generates a shareable URL with job title and company name.

9. Employer Analytics Dashboard — aggregated metrics including active jobs, total matches, like rate, match rate, pipeline stage breakdown, per-job performance, and interview statistics. Visual bar charts for pipeline distribution.

10. Candidate Swipe Enhancements — job cards now show save/bookmark button, social share buttons, assessment prompt badge, and match reason chips. Streamlined match score display.

New files (15):
- 7 API routes (pipeline, interviews, assessments, saved-jobs, job-alerts, employer-analytics, insights)
- 7 pages (pipeline, analytics, interviews, insights, saved, alerts, assessment)
- 1 component (ShareButtons)
- manifest.json

Updated (7):
- firebase.ts — 15+ new functions for pipeline, interviews, assessments, saved jobs, job alerts, analytics
- candidate swipe — save, share, assessment buttons
- dashboard — quick link cards for all new pages
- middleware — new protected routes
- firestore.rules — 5 new collection permissions
- layout — PWA manifest + viewport

22 files changed, 2257 insertions.
